description: What the Event Log service writes into an ordinary Security log without anyone clearing it: event 1100 each time the service shuts down with Windows, and 1101 when audit events were dropped. Both come from the same provider on the same channel as a clearing and differ only in the event id. Two ordinary Windows 11 machines measured on 2026-09-13 and 2026-09-14 held 1100 four times, and 1100 three times with 1101 once, and no 1102; the times and counts below are illustrative, not copied from either machine. A rule that also matched 1100 would name every player who has ever shut their PC down.
